Home.IntroParagraph1: I enjoy turning ideas into real products instead of leaving them as code on a screen. I like building things end-to-end, from mobile applications to backend services that actually solve problems.
Home.IntroParagraph2: I develop mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript. I’m also interested in the backend side, working with APIs, data flow, and system communication.
Home.IntroParagraph3: I set up a small self-hosted environment by turning an old PC at home into a Linux server. I’m also interested in networking, ESP32, and automation tools like n8n, and I enjoy connecting systems and automating workflows.

About.Heading: Get to know me!
About.Paragraph: Hi, my name is Ahmet Güneş and I’m based in İzmir, Turkey. I’m a Computer Engineering graduate with a focus on building mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript, while also being strongly interested in backend systems and infrastructure. I completed mobile and software development internships at Akbank, IsTechSoft, and Samsun Atakum Municipality, where I gained hands-on experience working on real-world applications and development workflows. Beyond application development, I enjoy experimenting with systems by turning an old PC at home into a small Linux server, and exploring networking, automation with n8n, and hardware projects like ESP32. I like building systems where different components communicate reliably and efficiently. I’m open to new opportunities, collaborations, and projects where I can contribute, learn, and grow. Feel free to reach out — you can find my links in the footer.

Projects.Heading: My Projects
Projects.WigglesDesc: An innovative pet management web app enabling pet parents to create unique pet IDs, securely store and share vaccination records, and generate QR codes for pet profiles, enhancing safety.
Projects.NewsletterDesc: A newsletter signup site made using Mailchimp API where the signups can be monitored from the MailChimp account. This project was made to understand API integration, environment variables and vercel deployment.
Projects.RogFreeDesc: A website that shows you over seven specialized yoga postures for specific diseases or health problems. This was a group project made in a team of two for a 36-hour-long online hackathon named Hackodisha 2.0.
Projects.TindogDesc: This website is a landing page of Tinder but for dogs. It is a responsive website which was made to understand Bootstrap. I also learned how to host my project on Github and then how to deploy that project using Github pages.
